item.title: Organise a key for a late visitor
item.context_text: A friend arrives after you leave for work. A café owner can help with the keys, but the café shuts early.
item.objective_text: Give the visitor a safe pickup plan and a fallback.
success_conditions: Give the visitor a safe pickup plan and a fallback.

children.title: Read the café hours
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Corner Café: Open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The owner can hand the key to Sam after three. Ask at the counter.

questions.explanation: The note authorises Sam to collect the key.

questions.prompt: When is the pickup window today?
questions.explanation: The owner can give it after three, and the café closes at five.

children.title: Hear your friend’s travel update
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: Hi! My bus is late. I can get to your street at half past five. I can wait in the park until you come home at six. My phone is still working.

questions.prompt: When will Sam reach the street?
Why is the café plan now a problem?
questions.explanation: Sam arrives half an hour after closing.

children.title: Call the café
children.prompt_text: You want to cancel the handover. The owner answers your call.
children.instructions: Say who will be late, ask the café to keep the key, and say when you will collect it.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Hi, this is Mel. Sam will be late today. Please keep the key. I will pick it up tomorrow morning. Thank you for your help.

points.label: Ask the café to keep the key
Say when you will collect it

children.title: Confirm where to meet
children.prompt_text: Text Sam before they get off the bus.
children.instructions: Explain why they should skip the café. Confirm what time and where you can meet, and ask for a text if the bus changes again.
children.goal: Give the visitor a safe pickup plan and a fallback.
children.model_answer: Hi Sam, the café shuts at five, so please go to the park. I can meet you by the park gate at six. Send me a text if your bus is late again. I will bring another key.
